verdict.rationale: Conductor has a cloud API and a hosted MCP server, so a webhooks axis fairly applies, but nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for events. Routines triggered by schedule or GitHub Action are inbound triggers, not event subscriptions, and the API docs only describe creating workspaces, sending prompts and reading replies.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
